subject: Notification badge clearing
description: Fixed an issue where the unseen notification count could stay visible after a player viewed unseen notifications.

subject: Language support
description: Users can now choose their preferred language, parents can update language settings for family members, and quests can support localized content.

subject: Newly added chores on dashboard
description: Fixed an issue where some newly added chores did not appear on the dashboard or all chores table right away.
